The '''Theed Courthouse''' was a building in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], it served as a rendezvous point for the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle to retake the city]] from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

==History==
The Theed Courthouse was a building constructed within the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. When the planet was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle]] to retake the planet was waged near the end of the conflict. When the [[Naboo Resistance]] and the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] began their assault on the city, the security forces led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] took control of area around the Courthouse and used it as a rendezvous point during the battle. Lieutenant Sykes and his comrades engaged the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and [[P-series droideka/Legends|destroyer droids]] stationed near the courthouse to clear the way for the [[Naboo commando transport|transport]] [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] carrying Security Force [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] to the city's [[Theed Hangar/Legends|main hangar]].<ref name="SWBN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Theed Courthouse appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''.
